Donald Trump refused to endorse JD Vance as he stood behind him in the Oval Office on Tuesday. Trump was asked about an interview Vance gave the day before where he said he believed the president would endorse him if he ran in 2028. 'Well, I tell you this, he's a very talented person,' Trump said. 'And he's a very good person, but I literally - I don't think we've ever talked about.' Vance standing behind him, said: 'No, sir. I said that too.' The vice president's face appeared to turn red and he laughed as the focus in the room turned to him. Trump continued: 'I don't talk about it with him, he doesn't talk about it with me. It's early. We are very early right now, we have to get through the midterms, we'll see how it goes.' Trump has repeatedly stopped short of anointing Vance his successor. He hedged in August by describing the vice president as the likely favorite but also floated Marco Rubio as a potential running mate.  Vance on Monday told veteran Washington journalist Mark Halperin, 'Look, I think I run, the president will endorse me ... but I don't know, man, I haven't talked to him about it.' #news #politics #trump #vance
